description: Fork of exp666 (1.4544 @ 92.8M, current tiny bs=16 SOTA). Single change: qk_sparsify_s 4 -> 1 (remove S-split from qk_lut). Keep qk_tph=64. Same param count (6*64*16*128 = 786,432 per layer = 4.72M total, identical to S=4 case). v_lut keeps S=4. Same per-token LUT bandwidth. Difference: qk_lut has 4x fewer tables, each 4x wider in n_outputs (6 LUT heads × 128 outputs each vs 24 LUT heads × 32 outputs each). Tests whether split-S=4 on qk is load-bearing structure or accidental at this scale. Reference: exp666 = 1.4544 (92.8M, current SOTA); underperforming = S-split is real value; matching/beating = S-split is dead weight. Total params expected ~92.8M (unchanged).
